item.description:
A new icon, and a better update experience

  • New app icon. The Harmony mark now fills its rounded square properly, instead of sitting in a smaller tile with grey edges around it.
  • Updates are checked every time you open Harmony, and once an hour while it stays open. Previously a check was skipped if you had reopened the app within the hour.
  • Update notices now name the build, not just the version, so it is clear exactly which copy you are moving to.
  • Harmony confirms when an update has finished, the first time it opens on the new version.
  • Buttons in update dialogs now use Harmony's own colour.

Nothing about your projects, tasks, payments or attachments changes in this release.
